title.en: Why does the W barrier come before W fill?

subtitle.zh: 从洁净底部到低电阻Plug，是连续的界面工程
subtitle.en: From a clean bottom to a low-resistance plug: a continuous interface-engineering sequence

body.en: Pre-clean Remove residues and expose the contact bottom

body.zh: 2；Ti；附着 / 吸杂/ 接触控制
3；TiN；抑制WF₆相关反应，提供成核界面
body.en: 3 TiN Suppress WF₆-related reactions and provide a nucleation interface

body.zh: 4；W成核；先建立薄而连续的起始层
body.en: 4 W nucleation First establish a thin, continuous starting layer

body.zh: 5；Bulk W；保持覆盖，避免孔口过早闭合
body.en: 5 Bulk W Maintain coverage and avoid premature opening closure
6 CMP Remove field W, leaving only the plug

body.zh: 底部洁净；无残留、无有机物、；无粒子
body.en: Clean bottom No residues or organics, and no particles

body.zh: Step Coverage；侧壁与底部膜厚一致，；无明显变薄
body.en: Step coverage Uniform sidewall and bottom film thickness, without obvious thinning

body.zh: 成核连续；无断点、无裸露，；连续成核
body.en: Continuous nucleation No breaks or exposed areas; continuous nucleation

body.zh: CMP终点；场区去除干净，Plug；不凹陷、不残留
body.en: CMP endpoint Clean removal from the field; the plug has no recess or residue

body.zh: 顺序不能乱：先把界面做对，再谈W能否填满
body.en: Keep the sequence: establish the interfaces before asking whether W can fill the opening
